title: The Ant and the Chrysalis
summary: An industrious ant mocked a motionless chrysalis hanging from a leaf: "I can run and gather grain, while you hang helpless in a shell!"...
full_text:
An industrious ant mocked a motionless chrysalis hanging from a leaf: "I can run and gather grain, while you hang helpless in a shell!"

Days later, the chrysalis opened, and a magnificent butterfly emerged, soaring on painted wings into the sun while the ant remained crawling in the dust.
moral: Do not mock the dormant chrysalis; tomorrow it will soar above your crawl.
